claim.pdf_says: ONLY    Object-view, SHARING clause, SHARING phrase, and USAGE clause
claim.markdown_says:
| ONLY | Object-view, SHARING clause, SHARING phrase, and |

USAGE clause
claim.why_it_matters: The wrapped 'USAGE clause' was detached from the ONLY row into a stray paragraph, so the table row for ONLY omits the USAGE clause context (USAGE ... OBJECT REFERENCE ... ONLY) and the table is split.

verdict.reasoning: Printed page 171 (PDF p195) shows one continuous table; the ONLY row's context cell wraps to a second line, reading 'Object-view, SHARING clause, SHARING phrase, and USAGE clause', and PARAGRAPH follows as an ordinary row. page-195.md line 24 ends the ONLY row at 'and |', line 26 holds 'USAGE clause' as a free paragraph outside any table, and lines 28-29 start a new table whose header row is '| PARAGRAPH | EXIT statement |'. The words are present, but the table is structurally broken. Anything that reads the table (a context-sensitive-word extractor, or a reader of the rendered table) gets ONLY without the USAGE clause context, and PARAGRAPH turns into a column header instead of a data row. Both quotes in the claim are accurate. This is a structural defect with no normative change to wording.
verdict.corrected_description: The ONLY row's wrapped continuation 'USAGE clause' sits outside the table as a stray paragraph. The table is split there, and the second fragment uses the PARAGRAPH / EXIT statement row as its header row, so PARAGRAPH is no longer a data row. Fix: '| ONLY | Object-view, SHARING clause, SHARING phrase, and USAGE clause |' as one continuous table with PARAGRAPH as a data row.
